name: From-Scratch LLM
tagline: 25M + 110M models, pretrained & SFT'd from zero in pure PyTorch
why: To prove I understand language models from the ground up — not just calling an API, but building the training loop, tokenizer, and architecture myself.
what: Two transformer models I trained from scratch using only PyTorch: a 25M and a 110M, both pretrained and supervised-fine-tuned by hand. Inference runs live on the host GPU so you can chat with them and judge the output quality.
disclaimer: Live demo on a personal GPU. These are models I trained from scratch, so output won't match commercial LLMs — that's the point. Inference may occasionally be slow or briefly unavailable depending on GPU load.
